capture_method: Executed the pre-change source from git archive HEAD in an isolated temporary directory. SqliteSchedulerStore.dump_state wrote v7/v8, dump_sequence_state wrote the prepared v3 definition, and dump_sequence_entry wrote the v3 entry. The fixture files append one LF framing byte; canonical_sha256 covers the exact pre-change writer output without that LF.
privacy: Synthetic repository path, identities, hashes, credential reference, model names, and timestamps; no live artifact or native conversation bytes.

fixtures.contract: submitted context v7 with historical Cursor SDK binding v1
materialized context v8 from frozen sequence definition/entry v3
prepared sequence state containing definition and entries v3
first frozen sequence entry v3 and its accepted entry hash
